d.t: A Mexican broadcast station whose signal overpowers those of stations in the United States.
d.e: Not long after the feds started regulating radio, Mexico's megawatt border blasters—high-powered stations planted just south of Texas and California—started beckoning. The FCC couldn't control them […] That same year, the Mexican government revised its radio licensing law…
